cards.text: Abner, the commander of Saul's army, just offered to bring all Israel over to David, and David sent him away in peace (2 Samuel 2:8; 3:21). Just then, David's soldiers and Joab son of Zeruiah get back from a raid with a great plunder (2 Samuel 2:13). But Abner's already gone.

When Joab and his troops arrive, somebody fills him in: Abner son of Ner came to see the king, and the king sent him on his way in peace. Joab walks in carrying a great plunder, and he's not even the headline.

cards.question: Joab hears Abner came and went in peace. Joab goes straight to King David. What does Joab do?

answers.text: Demands to know why David let Abner go
Thanks David for making peace with Abner
Hands David the plunder from the raid

cards.text: Joab says it right to the king's face: “What have you done?” Friend, I never said ONE word to the shiny new stamper that took my spot on the counter, and Joab just marches up and questions the KING.

cards.question: Joab keeps going. According to Joab, what did Abner come to Hebron to do?

answers.text: Deceive David and track his movements
Make peace and serve David as king
Challenge Joab to a fight in Hebron

cards.text: As soon as Joab leaves David, he sends messengers after Abner, and they bring him back from the well of Sirah. Abner's already on the road, and now he has to turn that WHOLE trip around.

cards.question: King David is unaware that Joab sent messengers to bring Abner back.

cards.text: Abner comes back to Hebron, and Joab pulls him aside into the gateway.

cards.question: Joab pulls Abner aside into the gateway at Hebron. How does Joab make it look?

answers.text: As if he wants to talk privately
As if he has a message from David
As if he is taking him to the king

cards.text: There in the gateway, Joab stabs Abner in the stomach. So Abner dies, on account of the blood of Asahel, Joab's brother.

cards.question: When David hears that Joab killed Abner, he says he and his kingdom are forever ___ before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner.
Next, David asks the LORD to forgive Joab and his father's house.

cards.text: David says may it whirl over the head of Joab and his father's whole house, and may that house never be without someone with a discharge or skin disease, someone who leans on a staff, falls by the sword or lacks food.

cards.question: Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner because Abner killed their brother Asahel. Where did Abner kill Asahel?

cards.text: Abner is dead, and now King David gives orders to Joab and all the people with him. I don't think Joab saw THIS assignment coming.

cards.question: After Abner's murder, what does King David order Joab and all the people with him to do?

answers.text: Tear their clothes and mourn Abner

cards.text: David's words: “Tear your clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourn before Abner.” Joab's in that crowd too, and I bet that sackcloth felt REAL heavy on him.

cards.question: King David himself walks behind Abner's funeral bier.

cards.text: They bury Abner in Hebron, the very town where Joab struck him down. Now the king stands at the tomb.

cards.question: At Abner's tomb in Hebron, what does King David do?

cards.text: All the people weep too. Then the king sings a lament for Abner, and it opens with a question: “Should Abner die the death of a fool?”

cards.question: In his lament, David sings that Abner's hands were not bound and his feet were not fettered. So how does David say Abner fell?

answers.text: As a man falls before the wicked
As a soldier falls in battle
As a traitor falls in judgment

cards.text: And all the people weep over Abner even more. Friend, the king's song just made a sad day even sadder.

cards.question: The people urge David to eat something while it's still day. What does David do?

answers.text: Swears not to eat before sunset
Eats with the people to comfort them
Eats a little to keep his strength

cards.question: The people take note of how David handles Abner's death, and they are unhappy with it.
On that day, all the troops and all Israel were ___ that the king had no part in the murder of Abner.

cards.text: Then the king turns to his servants with a question about the man they just buried.

cards.question: King David asks his servants if they realize that a great ___ has fallen today in Israel.

cards.text: Then David gets honest: he is weak this day, though anointed as king, and the sons of Zeruiah, Joab and his brother Abishai, are too fierce for him (2 Samuel 2:18). Friend, I've got a mustache that packs cookie boxes, and some mornings a stuck oven door is too fierce for ME.

cards.question: After saying the sons of Zeruiah are too fierce for him, what does David ask of the LORD?

answers.text: Repay the evildoer according to his evil
Spare the sons of Zeruiah from His anger
Grant the king strength against his foes

cards.text: We'll set the timer and step away from the oven right here. Friend, this batch isn't out yet.
